title: When you stop making excuses, you start becoming who God designed you to be.
paragraphs:
When you stop making excuses, you start becoming who God designed you to be.
Holiness doesn’t begin when life gets easier — it begins when you finally choose Him over comfort.
🔥 No turning back. No watering down. No excuses. Just Jesus.
“But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do.” — 1 Peter 1:15 (NIV)
